reason: The only available action adds mineral to the collagen framework, a sensible start toward stronger bones.
expectation: I expect a mineralized bone framework; I’m unsure how its living components will be added.

effect: The mineral adds compression resistance to the collagen framework; bone cells are the next available component.
reaction: The contrast between toughness and compression resistance makes the construction clear.
reason: Adding bone cells is the only offered combination and moves toward living bone.
expectation: I expect the cells to become part of the mineralised framework, though their precise role may need explaining.

effect: The cells connect through channels in the hard matrix, suggesting how living bone can exchange nutrients and signals.
reaction: The cutaway makes the cells' connection inside solid bone interesting.
reason: Adding blood vessels is the only offered combination and seems useful for supporting living bone.
expectation: I expect vessels to be incorporated into the bones, perhaps showing how they supply the cells.

effect: The vessel cutaway shows nutrients reaching embedded bone cells through the channel network, completing the living-bone construction.
reaction: The distinction between red cells staying in the vessel and nutrients leaving it is clear.
reason: Adding articular cartilage is the only offered combination and seems like a step toward a smooth-moving elbow.
expectation: I expect cartilage to cap the bone ends at the elbow, making their contact smoother.

effect: The cartilage caps the facing elbow surfaces and allows them to slide against one another.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's purpose clear.
reason: The synovial capsule is the only offered combination and seems relevant to enclosing the movable joint.
expectation: I expect the capsule to surround the elbow joint, with its fluid supporting smooth movement.

effect: The capsule encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide.
reaction: The explanation makes the fluid's role clear.
reason: Adding elbow ligaments is the only offered combination and should support the movable joint.
expectation: I expect the ligaments to span the elbow and help stabilize it.

effect: The completed skeleton shows the ligaments resisting sideways movement while the elbow bends, completing the goal.
reaction: The arrows make the ligaments’ stabilizing role clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding blood vessels was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway connects the vessels to the channel network and shows how nutrients reach embedded bone cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the cartilage and capsule felt somewhat repetitive as separate, only-available steps, though the capsule explanation clarified how fluid helps the surfaces glide.

surprise.text: The connected cells and tiny channels inside hard bone made living bone more interesting than a simple solid framework.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, although the sequence offered only one combination at each step. The term “articular cartilage” was not defined in words, but its placement and sliding inset helped explain it.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in continuing to see how muscles act on the skeleton, but the single-option sequence offered few meaningful choices.
